payload.title: Rollout: Papyrus 1.19.1 bumps on p.apyr.us and Pilobol.us, confirm in-build deploys ran
payload.description:
State as of 2026-10-19 16:40Z. Papyrus 1.19.1 is on npm (deploy quoting fix and edge parameter fix). Pilobol.us PR 96 merged, so its Amplify build (app d1eiwl0gedkmnj) now runs papyrus-infra deploy. p.apyr.us PR 42 was waiting on CI; merge it, then its build (app ds6yswxui41yi) runs deploy-edge, which adopts CloudFront E17ZRAI87DN065 and E2EM0JLBC2W9WW.

Next step: merge p.apyr.us 42 when CI is green, then confirm from the Amplify job logs that both builds ran their infra deploy and report the outcome.
Blocker: none known; cloud threads cannot read AWS, so build confirmation comes from GitHub checks or the Mac.
Owner thread: MVP rollout merges.
